## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek, quiet, and unobtrusive man who lacks willpower. Described as being born to be ruled, he lives a submissive life alongside his capable wife.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Thomas Lynde spent his early life ruled by his mother until he married [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who took over managing him. He lived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) for many years while she involved herself in local community affairs. After Thomas passed away, his death led [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P23](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0023), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026)_

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). Their household is a familiar part of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community alongside neighboring families like the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts). Following Thomas's death, [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) accepts an invitation from [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
